text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There, the bulletin boards are finished! I'll
have everything
princess-perfect in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You really don't mind helping me though?
Your whole day was almost
ruined because
of me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're so sweet! You know, if I ran
into you and not the wall,
you'd be the
one full of holes right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the office, Kawakami
Princess gives me a proper,
heartfelt
apology for almost running over me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I apologize as well, explaining that I
wanted to help her because I
should've
been watching where I was going.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tracen Academy is huge, isn't it?
Getting around the whole
school is going
to tire out even a princess like me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She talks about herself as if she's an actual
princess. I wonder if that
word has some
special meaning to her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, couldn't you tell by looking? Yep, I'm
a real-life princess. Just
like Princess
Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Tell me you've watched Spitfire Cutie☆Princess Fighter before! Everyone has!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She's a princess who races fair and square
against the wicked Dark
Umamusume.
She's the strongest warrior there
is—Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She never loses heart because of all the
love and support she gets
from her prince,
Legendary Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've wanted to become a princess since I
was a little kid. Everyone
always tells me
someone so wild can't be one though...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was the worst. It got me really
down, but then Princess
Fighter showed
me what to do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"A princess is always beautiful, graceful,
and courageous!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even a spitfire can be a princess! That's
why I came to Tracen—to
become a
strong, brave princess just like Princess
Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why's your face all scrunched up?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you think I'm dreaming too
big. You wouldn't joke
around like that,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's my dream—I'm the one who decides it,
and I'm the one who will
achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So what if I set high goals for myself? I'm
going to be just like Princess
Fighter, then
you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm really impressed by her daring attitude.
With conviction like that,
I bet she'll
become a terrific racer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What's this? Oh, if it isn't Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I-it's you! K-King! It's been s-so, er,
since morning! Good since
morning!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Good since morning?" I haven't heard that
before... Never mind
though. What are you
doing here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, you see... It's not like it looks. Air
Groove... from the student
council... told
me I, uh...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you helping the student council
now? Good for you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
To become first-rate, one must act the
part, and that includes
thankless service...
Heh. An admirable effort.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know, if you need it, I could help out
if you want.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Don't be crazy! This is my job, so
I've gotta do it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? All right, I'll be on my way
then. Keep up the good work.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: She's...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just wonderful! Perfect! Just look at the
way she carries herself so
beautifully!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking—King might be the
Umamusume most like Princess
Fighter in
the world!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I mean it! She's already perfect! She's got
beauty, refinement,
dignity...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I sure do! I've aspired to be like her ever
since I saw her the first time
I came to the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
She's always so grand and majestic. And
the way she moves, it's like,
uh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that! She's elegant! That's what
really makes a
princess—elegance!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And she complimented me... This won't do at all! I've got to finish these chores on my own!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Well, good day to you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(She complimented me! I was
complimented by King! I just need to
keep
it up a little longer until the tryouts. Then I
can be a princess
too!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(A princess... like King... Wait, can I even
compare to King—like, be
her equal?)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Here, look at this. The princess in this
book is well-behaved, isn't
she? If you
want to become a princess, you'll have to
be nice and
quiet like her.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(No way. Is that what Mom was trying to
tell me? That if I can't be like
King, I can't
become a princess?!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-but I'm not anything like her!
